Summary: When Percy joined the internet, through phones made by the Hephaestus Cabin, he didn't think he, current friends, and new friends, would cause such chaos. When Danny joined the internet, on a phone modified by Tucker and supplied to Amity via Vlad to prevent ghostly interference, he didn't think he'd make friends with so many chaos gremlins, one of which, he is. When Tim Drake-Wayne made a point to connect with all the teenage people related to their own massive (blowing up and jumping off the St. Louis Gateway Arch at twelve) issues, he didn't expect valid reasons, more cults, less heroism, and vigilantism, of it's own kind. When Peter Parker-Stark allowed his adoptive father, Tony Stark, to announce his adoption. He didn't think he'd be the chaos gremlin his friends say he is, being more a mother chaos gremlin. Nor did he think he'd meet people like him, err, similar to him. In regards of chaos. Harry Potter finally got his friend, Hermione Granger, to agree to helping him put runes in phones, subsequently getting muggle technology to run off of magic and work properly. Summary: “Has Robin always been this, uh…” There’s a pause that grows heavier the longer it lingers. “Stoic?” Superboy sighs. “I dunno. Maybe?
